sections.overview:
This skill provides a collection of 150 practical n8n automation templates built for real-world use cases. The templates cover lead generation, follow-ups, AI workflows, and API integrations, allowing you to implement automation without building from scratch. Designed to help teams streamline repetitive tasks and scale operations efficiently.

Create AI-driven workflows
